322 & 328 Adams Street – Double Lot Development Opportunity

Offered together, 322 and 328 Adams Street provide a rare chance to acquire two adjacent parcels totaling approximately .225 acres with over 90 feet of combined frontage. The lots measure approximately 61 x 112 (.15 acres) and 30 x 112 (.075 acres), creating a versatile development site with room for thoughtful design and larger building footprints than typically found in the neighborhood.

The combined acreage allows space for a variety of possibilities including new construction, gardens, outdoor gathering areas, or small-scale residential development. With generous frontage and depth, this assemblage presents an excellent opportunity for builders or visionaries looking to create something lasting within Buffalo’s evolving East Side landscape.

Additional Opportunity:
This property can also be purchased as part of a larger assemblage including nine lots on Peckham Street totaling approximately 0.91 acres (MLS #B1665930), the parsonage duplex at 308 Adams Street (MLS #B1665682), and two additional vacant lot listings within one block (MLS #B1665990, MLS #B1666042). The combined properties offer expanded development potential and flexibility for a larger project footprint. Equal Housing Opportunity!
